chunks: From a single sperm He created, then proportioned him,

key_terms.خَلَقَهُ: He created him, referring to the act of bringing into existence.
key_terms.فَقَدَّرَهُ: Then He proportioned/determined him, referring to shaping and measuring the creation with precision.
key_terms.نُطْفَةٍ: A drop of fluid, specifically semen or sperm, referring to the initial stage of human creation.

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'He created from a nutfah and then proportioned him'?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-‘Abasa, this verse underscores the paradox of divine precision versus human arrogance, reminding the Prophet that the Creator who meticulously designed the human form from a mere drop of fluid is fully capable of guiding or withholding guidance as He wills. Shia exegesis often highlights this as a reminder of God's absolute sovereignty over both physical creation and spiritual destiny, challenging the notion that outward status correlates with divine favor.
